summary: Keep missing launch inputs path-scoped and re-evaluate only declarations whose inputs changed

schema.detail: Watch dependencies and pending launch evaluations remain in memory. Performance counters add scoped_launch_notifications and scoped_launch_evaluations.

compatibility.detail: Missing nested input watches retain their full declared path instead of accepting all writes below the first missing component. Creation of missing ancestors and replacement still refresh coverage; delayed creation events for an already-existing watch root do not invalidate its inputs. Launch-input changes use the dependency follower instead of waking a full reconcile pass; genuine lost-event rescans still fail closed. Identity completion carries its exact filesystem measurement dependency snapshot and queues only declarations mapped to that measurement. Completion during reader registration or an overlapping filesystem change retains a scoped retry.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary deployment restart.

manual.detail: No configuration or state repair is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes; normal restart reconstructs subscriptions and dependencies.
